en.text: "I just ran into a friend today who had transferred schools a while back." "Cool!" "Yeah. Then, we talked about movies, and they suggested we go watch one sometime soon. Is that OK?" "Sure! But, is this friend a boy or a girl?" "....."

original: トムとメアリーの二人がそこに居合わせたのは単なる偶然ではなかった。

en.text: It wasn't simply by coincidence that Tom and Mary both happened to be there.

original: 偶然、彼女に出くわした。

en.text: I met her by accident.
Coincidentally, I came across my girlfriend.

original: 私達は偶然同じ電車に乗り合わせた。

en.text: We happened to take the same train.

original: 偶然、居合わせただけよ。

en.text: I just happened to be there at that time.

original: 純粋な幸せは偶然に見つかるって言ってた。

en.text: They say that true happiness is found accidentally.

original: 古本屋で偶然出会った一冊が、今では一番のお気に入りだ。

en.text: A book I happened to come across at a secondhand bookstore has now become my favorite.
